result.topic_en: Formula-only calculations on the dilogarithm function $\varrho(x)=\int \log x\, dx/(1-x)$: functional equations (reflection, inversion, multiplication), its value on the unit circle, a series expansion of $\int\log q\,dq/q$, and a five-term-type relation for the dilogarithm of cross-ratios.
result.transcription:
$\int \log q \frac{\partial q}{q} = \frac12(\log q+\nu(q))^2 + \sum (-1)^s \frac{q}{s^2}\log(1+q^s) = (\log q - \frac{s}{2} i)^2 + \sum(-1)^s \frac{2}{s^2}(\ldots)$ [?] $= \ldots + \sum_{1,\infty}(-1)^s\frac{2}{s^2}\log 2 + \sum_{-\infty,\infty}(-1)^s \frac{2}{s^2}\log\ldots$ [?]
$+\sum_{1,\infty}(-1)^s\frac{2}{s^2}\ldots$ [?]
$\sum_{0,\infty}\frac{1}{(\nu+n)^2}$ [?] $= -\int_0^1 \log x \frac{x^{\nu-1}\partial x}{1-x^n} = \frac1n\int_0^1\sum_{0,1,n}\log x \frac{-x^{\ldots}\partial x}{1-\alpha^s x}\,\alpha^{-\nu s}, \quad \alpha = e^{\frac{2\pi i}{n}}$
$= \frac{1}{n}\sum\left(\int_0^{\alpha^s}\log x\frac{-\partial x}{1-x} - 2\pi i\left(\frac{s}{n}\right)\int_0^{\alpha^s}\frac{-\partial x}{1-x}\right)\alpha^{-\nu s}$
$\int_1^x \log x\frac{\partial x}{1-x} = \varrho(x)$
$= -\log x\log 1-x + \int_1^x \log 1-x\frac{\partial x}{x}$
$= \int -\log x\log 1-x + \int_0^{1-x}\log x\frac{-\partial x}{1-x} = -\log x\log(1-x) + \int_0^1 \log x\frac{-\partial x}{1-x} - \varrho(1-x)$
$\varrho x + \varrho(1-x) = -\log x\log(1-x) + \int_0^1\log x\frac{-\partial x}{1-x} \qquad \varrho x + \varrho\frac1x = -\frac12(\log x)^2$
$\int_1^{e^{\varrho i}} \varrho(e^{\varrho i}) = \int_0^\varrho \varrho i\frac{e^{\varrho i}\partial\varrho i}{1-e^{\varrho i}} = \int_0^\varrho \varrho i\frac{e^{\frac{\varrho}{2}i}\partial\varrho i}{-2\sin\frac{\varrho}{2} i} = -\frac{i}{2}\int_0^\varrho(\cot\frac{\varrho}{2}+i)\varrho\partial\varrho = \frac{i}{2}\int_0^\varrho \varrho\partial\varrho - \frac{i}{2}\int_0^\varrho \cot\frac{\varrho}{2}\varrho\partial\varrho$
[-\ldots-]
$\varrho x = -\int_1^x \log x\,\partial\log(1-x) = \int_1^x \log x\,\partial(\log 1-x - \log x) = -\frac12(\log x)^2 - \varrho\frac1x$
$\varrho x^n = \int_0^x n\log x\,\partial\sum\log(1-\alpha x) + \int_0^1\log x\frac{-\partial x}{1-x}$
$= \int_0^1 \log x\frac{-\partial x}{1-x} + n\sum\log x\log(1-\alpha x)$ [-\ldots-] $+ n\sum\varrho\alpha x$
$\sum_{-\infty}^{\infty}\frac{1}{(\nu+x)^2} = \frac{\pi^2}{(\sin x\pi)^2}$
[-$\frac{1}{(\sin x\pi)^2} = \frac{1}{\pi^2}\sum\frac{1}{\ldots}$-]
$\int_1^x \log x\frac{\partial x}{1-x} + \frac12\log x\log 1-x + \frac12\int_0^1\log x\frac{\partial x}{1-x} = \varphi_x$
$\int_\beta^\delta \log\left(\frac{x-\alpha}{\beta-\alpha}\right)\partial\log(x-\beta) - \frac12\log\frac{\delta-\beta}{\alpha-\beta}\log\frac{\delta-\alpha}{\beta-\alpha} - \frac12\varrho_0 = \varrho\left(\frac{\delta-\alpha}{\beta-\alpha}\right)$
$x-\alpha = z(\beta-\alpha)$ [?]
$= \int_1^z \log z\,\partial\log(1-z) - \frac12\log(1-z)\log z$
$z \mp \frac{\beta-\gamma}{\gamma-z} \quad \frac{\gamma z-\beta}{z-1} \mp z$ [?]
$\int_1^x \log x\,\partial\log(1-x) = \int_1^{\alpha x}\log\frac{z}{\alpha}\,\partial\log(\alpha-z)$
$= \int_1^{\frac{\alpha\gamma x-\beta}{\alpha x-1}} \log\frac{\beta-z}{\alpha(\gamma-z)}\,\partial\log\frac{\alpha(\gamma-z)-\beta-z}{\gamma-z}$
$\int_{\varepsilon-\alpha}^{\delta-\alpha}\log z\,\partial\log(\ldots)$ [?]
[-$= \int \log\frac{\beta-z}{\ldots}\,\partial(\log\gamma-z)$-]
$\int_\varepsilon^\delta \log\frac{x-\alpha}{x-\beta}\,\partial\log\frac{x-\gamma}{x-\beta} = \int_{\frac{\varepsilon-\alpha}{\varepsilon-\beta}}^{\frac{\delta-\alpha}{\delta-\beta}}\log z\,\partial\log\left(1 - \frac{\beta-\gamma}{\alpha-\gamma}z\right)$
$= \varrho\left(\frac{\beta-\gamma}{\alpha-\gamma}\frac{\varepsilon-\alpha}{\varepsilon-\beta}\right) - \varrho\left(\frac{\delta-\alpha}{\delta-\beta}\frac{\beta-\gamma}{\alpha-\gamma}\right) - \log\frac{\beta-\gamma}{\alpha-\gamma}\log\left(1-\frac{\beta-\gamma}{\alpha-\gamma}\frac{\delta-\alpha}{\delta-\beta}\right) + \log\frac{\beta-\gamma}{\alpha-\gamma}\log\left(1-\frac{\beta-\gamma}{\alpha-\gamma}\frac{\varepsilon-\alpha}{\varepsilon-\beta}\right)$
$=$

methods.what: Definition of the dilogarithm-type function rho
Dilogarithm on the unit circle via cotangent integral
Multiplication (distribution) formula for the dilogarithm over n-th roots of unity
Hurwitz-type sum expressed through dilogarithms at roots of unity
Integral of log of cross-ratio expressed via dilogarithms of cross-ratio products (five-term-type relation)
